Package org.thewhitemage13.service

Class EmailValidationService

java.lang.Object
org.thewhitemage13.service.EmailValidationService
All Implemented Interfaces:
EmailValidationServiceInterface
@Service public class EmailValidationService extends Object implements EmailValidationServiceInterface
Service for validating email addresses.

This service handles email validation operations, including checking whether an email is correctly formatted and whether the email is already in use by another user. It uses EmailValidator to validate the email format and the UserRepository to check the uniqueness of the email.

Key Features:

  • Validates email format using Apache Commons Validator.
  • Checks if an email is already taken in the system.
  • Throws custom exceptions if the email is invalid or already in use.

    • validateEmailBeforeUpdate

      public void validateEmailBeforeUpdate(String checkEmail) throws EmailBusyException
      Validates the email format before updating.

      This method checks if the email is valid according to the EmailValidator. If the format is incorrect, it throws an IncorrectEmailFormatException.

      Specified by:
      validateEmailBeforeUpdate in interface EmailValidationServiceInterface
      Parameters:
      checkEmail - the email to be validated
      Throws:
      EmailBusyException - if the email is already in use (this exception is not used in this method)
      IncorrectEmailFormatException - if the email format is invalid

    • validateUniqueEmail

      public void validateUniqueEmail(String checkEmail) throws EmailBusyException
      Validates that the email is both correctly formatted and unique.

      This method first checks if the email already exists in the system. If the email is taken, it throws an EmailBusyException. If the email format is invalid, it throws an IncorrectEmailFormatException.

      Specified by:
      validateUniqueEmail in interface EmailValidationServiceInterface
      Parameters:
      checkEmail - the email to be validated
      Throws:
      EmailBusyException - if the email is already taken
      IncorrectEmailFormatException - if the email format is invalid
